package rulefixtures

import "fmt"

// scenario for go_perf_layer_error_handling_cost_panic_recover_for_control_flow: Layer: Error handling cost. Flag panic/recover used for expected branch control in performance-sensitive code.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func ProcessBatch(items []string) (err error) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			err = fmt.Errorf("batch aborted: %v", r)
		}
	}()
	for _, item := range items {
		if item == "" {
			panic(fmt.Errorf("empty item"))
		}
		if len(item) > 100 {
			panic(fmt.Errorf("item too long: %d", len(item)))
		}
	}
	return nil
}
